The 279-path manifest equals the committed tree. Product bytes are unchanged since round4. QBrain INVITE-COPY-01/02/03 and TR-23-C02 are live, unsatisfied, mapped and in the canonical export. Nothing is claimed done or deployed. No credential appears in any tracked file or public copy.

Why DISAGREE:
F-R5-1 (low): the original reaction failure and three failed clock experiments are retained but nowhere analyzed; error-context attachments were not retained and experiment receipts lack command, host and run id. Round4 asked for this; no disposition was recorded. The original cause remains unproven, and my mechanism inferences do not establish it.
F-R5-2 (low): planner provenance does not give exact commands or exit codes (planner-mock is a paraphrased configuration; the module binding is outside the command; no committed script produces mock.xml); the script contracts have no JUnit/TRX and are not indexed.

UNKNOWN: runtime effort; prior failsafe 5ca5 fate; plan approval before the Copy Invitation Link implementation; remote wiki state (fetch denied).
I-R5-1 to I-R5-9 are informational, including that the browser reaction case checks the display at 250 ms ticks while the component case pins the exact boundary.
